title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The improved resilience of vulnerable populations programme in the Democratic Republic of Congo implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to improve the capacity of vulnerable displaced, returnee and host families, to cope with recurring shocks such as natural disasters and conflict. The objectives of the programme is to provide cash transfers and life skills training for households from fragile communities that have recently been affected by crisis; to ensure the safe and timely access to life-saving food and non-food items; and to support households to protect and rebuild their livelihoods. The programme also works to challenge negative gender sterotypes and behaviours in the communtiy through gender transformative discussion activities.. Local partners play a central role in implementation. SOCOAC delivered functional literacy activities to strengthen participants’ ability to manage IGAs and savings. EADEV led community and household-level activities on gender-transformative approaches and protection, while SOFEPADI implemented social cohesion and conflict transformation activities through community dialogues and engagement with local leaders.
